LOCAL DISCOVERY ONLY: the token was bound to a loopback tunnel host and is NOT valid at any hosted URL. No tokens, codes, host identifiers, argument payloads or secrets are included; schemas are reduced to property names, types, enums and descriptions.

tools.name: t3_project_update
tools.description: Update a registered project's settings. Omitted fields are preserved. Uses the same project service as the app.

tools.name: t3_project_delete
tools.description: Delete a project using the existing project deletion lifecycle. Nonempty projects require force=true. This does not delete the repository directory or promise a deleted-thread count.

tools.name: t3_project_clone
tools.description: Clone a repository using the app's source-control service. This only clones; register the returned cwd with t3_project_create. An existing destination is not adopted or removed on failure.

tools.name: t3_environment_read
tools.description: Read this server's identity and selected environment preferences. Provider/model availability is exposed by orchestrator_capabilities. Writing instructions are limited to 4,000 characters.

tools.name: t3_environment_preferences_update
tools.description: Update selected environment-wide preferences through normal settings persistence and notifications. Requires a live full-access/default calling thread. Omitted fields are preserved; empty customInstructions clears them.

tools.name: t3_preview_list
tools.description: List this thread's preview tabs. Pages reflect the current server state and may shift as tabs change.

tools.name: t3_preview_close
tools.description: Close one preview tab owned by this thread through the normal server/host tab lifecycle. This does not wait for renderer cleanup.

tools.name: t3_worktree_handoff
tools.description: Needs an agent running inside a T3 thread. Move this agent thread into a new git worktree. To launch a separate agent already bound to a new or existing worktree, use t3_thread_launch with workspaceStrategy instead. Creates the worktree branch (optionally from origin), re-points the thread at the wo

Run the project's configured setup script in the new worktree after handoff. Defaults to true.

tools.name: t3_worktree_status
tools.description: Needs an agent running inside a T3 thread. Report this agent thread's worktree binding: whether it is attached to a git worktree, the worktree path and branch, the project's main workspace root, and the server default for t3_worktree_handoff's startFromOrigin. Call this before t3_worktree_handoff to

tools.name: t3_worktree_list
tools.description: List branch refs and their associated checkout paths for a thread's workspace (omit threadId for this thread) using the app's ref inventory. Detached worktrees without a branch are not included. Use t3_worktree_status for the thread binding and t3_worktree_handoff to create a new worktree.

tools.name: link_pull_request
tools.description: Register every pull request you open for this thread, including each layer of a stack, right after creating it. anyOf.description: Pull request number. Required with repository when url is omitted.

tools.name: unlink_pull_request
tools.description: Remove a pull request link from this thread, for example after closing a pull request you opened by mistake. Pass the URL, or repository plus number. Unlinking a pull request that is not linked succeeds with wasLinked=false.

anyOf.description: Pull request number. Required with repository when url is omitted.

tools.name: list_thread_pull_requests
tools.description: List the pull requests linked to a thread (omit threadId for this thread) with their last known host state, and how they chain into stacks (bottom to top). Register every pull request you open for this thread, including each layer of a stack, right after creating it.

tools.name: watch_pull_request
tools.description: Have T3 Code watch an open pull request for this thread, linking it first if needed. anyOf.description: Pull request number. Required with repository when url is omitted.

tools.name: unwatch_pull_request
tools.description: Stop T3 Code from watching a pull request for this thread. The pull request stays linked. Pass the URL, or repository plus number.

anyOf.description: Pull request number. Required with repository when url is omitted.

tools.name: device_list
tools.description: List iOS Simulators and Android Emulators on this environment's device hosts, which platforms each host can run, and which devices are already open in this thread's Device panel. Call this before device_open when you do not know a device id.

anyOf.description: Limit to one device host. Defaults to all hosts.

tools.name: device_open
tools.description: Open a simulator or emulator for this thread: boots it if needed, starts its live stream, and shows it in the user's Device panel so they can watch. Returns the agent-device CLI invocation pinned to the device; drive the device with that CLI afterwards.

inputSchema.description: Boots the device if needed, starts its live stream, and opens the Device panel so the user can watch. Returns how to drive it with the agent-device CLI.

anyOf.description: Required when deviceId is omitted and both platforms are available.

tools.name: device_close
tools.description: Remove a device from this thread's Device panel. Pass shutdown=true to also power the simulator or emulator off.

anyOf.description: Also power the simulator or emulator off. Defaults to false.

tools.name: device_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the current screen of an open device as a PNG image. Use it to see what the user sees; for taps and text use the agent-device CLI.

tools.name: html_render
